name: review-duplication
summary: 发布者提供的 review-duplication 审查清单可帮助你判断代码变更是否重复实现了仓库中的已有逻辑。先梳理变更中的核心逻辑，再追踪依赖，并到可能存放共享工具或组件的目录中查找。示例路径采用特定的仓库结构，需按项目实际布局调整。

The publisher’s review-duplication checklist helps you check whether a code change reimplements logic already in the repository. Start with the changed logic, then trace dependencies and check likely locations for shared utilities or components. The example paths follow a specific repository layout, so adapt them to your project.
